descriptionChirho: The proper noun עֲמֹרָה designating the ancient city of Gomorrah, destroyed alongside Sodom by divine judgment (Gen 19). All three clusters are the same toponym with different prepositional or conjunctive prefixes. Multilingual evidence: English 'Gomorrah,' Spanish 'Gomorra,' Hindi अमोरा/अमोरह, Arabic عَمُورَة (consistent transliteration across all clusters), Korean 고모라, Swahili Gomora. The simile use 'like Gomorrah' (S125082, כַּעֲמֹרָה) in prophetic warnings (Isa 1:10, 13:19; Jer 23:14; 49:18; 50:40; Amos 4:11; Zeph 2:9; Deut 29:22) does not create a separate sense -- it is the same city referenced in comparative constructions. All 19 occurrences refer to one and the same place.
